Package neqsim.pvtsimulation.util

Class CalibratedPvtModel

java.lang.Object
neqsim.pvtsimulation.util.CalibratedPvtModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class CalibratedPvtModel extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable original/tuned EOS checkpoints and independently identified laboratory calibration evidence.

This class does not fit an EOS or accept reservoir history as laboratory data. It reuses PVTFluidStudy to compare both checkpoints with complete held-out laboratory experiments. Experiment identities must identify whole experiments, not individual rows of a depletion path. Identity disjointness is checked; the caller remains responsible for actual laboratory provenance and independence. Supported fluid models and standard conditions are those of PVTFluidStudy. Native checkpoints require a compatible NeqSim/software version.

Version:
1.0
Author:
Even Solbraa

    • compareHoldout

      public String compareHoldout(String experimentId, String kind, double temperatureK, double[] pressuresBara, String property, double[] measured, double[] uncertainty)
      Replays a complete held-out CCE, CVD or DLE protocol for both models.

      Every observation is aligned to the full ordered pressure schedule, including its initial point. The property name and units are the normalized PVTFluidStudy JSON keys. Uncertainty is a supplied positive one-standard-deviation measurement scale, not an inferred confidence interval. No automatic calibration acceptance threshold is imposed.

      Parameters:
      experimentId - whole held-out experiment identity, absent from calibration
      kind - CCE, CVD or DLE (case sensitive)
      temperatureK - laboratory temperature in K
      pressuresBara - complete decreasing laboratory pressure schedule in bara
      property - normalized property key, for example boM3PerSm3 for DLE
      measured - measured values in that property's units, one per pressure
      uncertainty - positive measurement standard deviations in the same units
      Returns:
      JSON predictions, observed-minus-predicted residuals and standardized residuals

    • compareSeparatorHoldout

      public String compareSeparatorHoldout(String experimentId, double reservoirTemperatureK, double reservoirPressureBara, double[] stagePressuresBara, double[] stageTemperaturesK, String property, double measured, double uncertainty)
      Replays a complete held-out separator/stock-tank train on the 15 C, 1.01325 bara standard basis.
      Parameters:
      experimentId - whole held-out experiment identity
      reservoirTemperatureK - initial reservoir temperature in K
      reservoirPressureBara - initial reservoir pressure in bara
      stagePressuresBara - decreasing separator pressures ending at 1.01325 bara
      stageTemperaturesK - stage temperatures ending at 288.15 K
      property - totalGORSm3PerSm3, boM3PerSm3 or stockTankOilDensityKgPerM3
      measured - laboratory value in the property units
      uncertainty - positive measurement standard deviation in those units
      Returns:
      JSON predictions and residuals with the complete declared separator path
